 The Council of Higher Secondary Education and Board of Secondary Education Manipur have declared the Manipur board Class 10 and Class 12 date sheets for the 2027 examination cycle
 Manipur board class 10, 12 date sheet 2027 out
 Princess Sonika New Delhi 3 min read Last Updated : Nov 12 2026 | 10:56 AM IST Listen to This Article
 The Council of Higher Secondary Education and Board of Secondary Education Manipur have declared the Manipur board High School Leaving Certificate (HSLC) Class 10 and Higher Secondary (Class 12) examination schedule 2027.    As per the official statement issued, the board will conduct the Class 12 examinations from February 11 to March 19, 2027. Meanwhile, the Manipur board HSLC exams will be conducted from February 10 to 25, 2027. How to download the Manipur class 10th exam timetable 2027?
 Visit the official website of BSEM at bsem.nic.in.   Open the "Notifications" or "Latest News" section on the homepage.   Press the link for "HSLC Examination 2027 Time Table".   Also Read

 Visit the official website of COHSEM at cohsem.nic.in.   Click on the "Notice" or "Latest Updates" section.   Choose the link for "HSE Examination 2027 Time Table".   The PDF will show in a new window.   Download and save the time table for your reference.   ALSO READ:  CBSE board exams 2027: Class 10, 12 datesheet released, check key dates Manipur Board HSLC Class 10 Time Table 2027
 February 10, 2027: English   February 12, 2027: Optional Subjects: Home Science, Commerce, Computer Science, Higher Mathematics, Thang-Ta, Fine Arts, Eshei Nongmai and Manipuri Jagoi   February 16, 2027: Social Science   February 19, 2027: First Language: Manipuri (MM), Bengali, Mizo, Paite, Zou, Hmar, Tangkhul, Nepali, Thadou, Kuki, Maola, Kom, Vaiphei, Ruangmei, Liangmei, Hindi, Sanskrit, Gangte and Simte   February 19, 2027: Subjects instead of First Language: Elementary Hindi, Additional English, Elementary Manipuri (MM) and Elementary Manipuri (Roman Script).   ALSO READ:  Maharashtra Board 10th, 12th Exam date 2027 out: Check complete schedule More about the Manipur board HSLC exams 2027
 The board informed Class 10 students that papers carrying 80 marks will be held for 3 hours in the morning shift (9 am to 12 pm), while papers with 48 marks will be conducted for 2 hours (9 am to 11 am). Manipur Board Higher Secondary Class 12 Exam Schedule
 February 11: MIL (Kom, Manipuri, Mao La, Bengali, Hindi, Hmar, Mizo, Nepali, Paite, Vaiphei, Zou, Raugmei, Tangkhul, Thadou-Kuki, Gangte) or Alternative English   February 13: Elective Languages - Hindi, Manipuri, Bengali, English   February 17: English   February 23: Physics, Political Science, Accountancy   February 26: Chemistry, Education, Business Studies   March 1: History, Biology   March 3: Engineering Drawing, Sociology   March 5: Human Ecology, Family Sciences   March 8: Mathematics   March 11: Fine Arts, Health, Physical Education   March 13: Psychology, Music, Thang Ta, Statistics.   March 15: Computer Science, Philosophy   March 17: Geology, Geography   March 19: Anthropology, Economics.  More about the Manipur Board HSE exams 2027
 The Manipur Board HSE Class 12 examinations will be held in the morning shift from 10 am to 1 pm. For Class 12 students, the exam duration will be 3 hours for papers carrying 70, 80, or 100 marks, while papers carrying 40 marks will be held for 2 hours.    The examinations will be conducted in the morning shift, with the 3-hour papers planned from 10 am to 1 pm and the 2-hour papers from 10 am to 12 noon.   ALSO READ:  MP Board timetable 2027 out: Class 10th, 12th exams to be held in Feb-Mar   More From This Section
